sources.label: NAUR LesBin - Crystallize Time - Early Pop

steps.title: Go to your Crystallize Time spot
steps.cue: Gaia casts Speed: yellow tethers north-south, purple on one diagonal
steps.rule: Red Aero: south-west or south-east wall. Red Ice: west or east, 12 m out, to catch a dragon head. Blue Eruption: the north purple corner. Other blues: the south purple corner. A red pair splits by H2 > H1 > OT > MT > M1 > M2 > R1 > R2, the first taking west.

steps.title: Line up for the Aero knockback
steps.rule: The south blue group slides along the wall toward due south so the Aero on its side stands just behind it and knocks it north; both Aeros shift toward due south as well. Red Ice and the Eruption hold.

steps.title: Red Ice: dodge out to the wall
steps.cue: Your dragon head pops on you
steps.rule: Red Ice: once your dragon head has hit you, step out to the wall on your side, slightly north, clear of the puddle it drops.

steps.title: Land in the north purple corner
steps.cue: Dark Aero III knocks the group north
steps.rule: The knocked-back blues land in the north purple corner with the Eruption; the red Ice on that side joins them, the other red Ice waits at its wall slightly south. Aeros stay near the south wall.

steps.title: Aeros into the south circle
steps.rule: Both Aeros step in to the south circle to meet their dragon heads; the red Ice on the south-purple side moves up to the north corner on its side.

steps.title: Gather north for the exalines
steps.cue: Tidal Light cast starts: Shiva moves east or west
steps.rule: After Unholy Darkness, everyone but the Aeros gathers at the north edge beside the crystal (never let a stack clip it); the two blues whose cleanse is on the side away from Shiva stand a bit toward that side.

steps.title: Aero: back to the south circle
steps.cue: Your dragon head pops on you
steps.rule: Aero: as soon as your dragon head pops on you, run back to the south circle.

steps.title: First cleanse on the far side
steps.rule: The far-side cleanses start: with Shiva east, the Eruption cleanses in the west puddle and the blue Ice heads toward waymark 4; with Shiva west, Unholy cleanses in the east puddle and Water heads toward waymark 3. Everyone else holds.

steps.title: Reds behind the first wave, near cleanses
steps.rule: Reds gather about 8 m out on Shiva's side, behind the first wave. The blues whose cleanse is on Shiva's side grab their puddles there (Unholy and Water when she is east, Eruption and Ice when she is west).

steps.title: Toward the exaline corner
steps.cue: The second Tidal Light cast starts
steps.rule: The next waves come from north or south: reds move about 10 m out toward the corner both wave sets start from; the last blue keeps chasing its puddle along behind the waves.

steps.title: Cleansed: wait for the waves
steps.rule: Once your puddle cleanses you, move to your waiting spot on the way to the exaline corner, dodging into the waves behind them.

steps.title: Gather in the exaline corner
steps.rule: Everyone heads into the corner both exaline sets started from, about 14 m out; a blue still cleansing joins after its puddle.

steps.title: Place Return at the corner waymark
steps.rule: Split into light parties on the corner waymark: group 1 (MT, H1, M1, R1) on the left and group 2 on the right as you face the wall, tanks a few steps further out than their group. Hold still while Return saves your spot.

steps.title: Akh Morn: MT solo, party stacks
steps.rule: 7-1 Akh Morn: everyone stacks in the middle while the MT takes his share alone about 9 m west.

MainTank.rule: Take Akh Morn alone about 9 m west of the middle, away from the party stack.

steps.title: Stack for Morn Afah
steps.rule: Everyone, MT included, stacks in the middle for Morn Afah.
